explanation: The statement `Subtype.val '' Iic c = Ioc a c` for `c : Ioc a b` is a specific one-off lemma of the `image_subtype_val_*` family in `Mathlib/Order/Interval/Set/Image.lean`, whose private helper `image_subtype_val_Ixx_Iix` plus `Subtype.image_preimage_val` and an intersection computation are needed (two lines of glue do not suffice). I searched Mathlib for all `Subtype.val '' Iic/Iio ...` lemmas (`image_subtype_val_Iic_subset`, `image_subtype_val_Ici_Iic`, `image_subtype_val_Ioi_Iic`, `image_subtype_val_Icc_Iic`, `image_subtype_val_Ico_Iic`, `image_subtype_val_Ioo_Iic`, and the `OrdConnected.image_subtype_val_*` family) as well as `Subtype.image_preimage_val` and related `image_coe_Iic` lemmas (NNReal, EReal, ENNReal, Exp, Fin). The closest, `image_subtype_val_Ioi_Iic`, has its second argument in the subtype `Ioi a`, not `Ioc a b`, and `image_subtype_val_Ioo_Iic` uses a different subtype `Ioo a b`; neither is reachable from the target by instantiating an argument, so no declaration with this exact statement exists in Mathlib/Batteries/Lean core.
